newsitem.title: CHINA: China oil corp criticises forced diesel sales.
newsitem.headline: China oil corp criticises forced diesel sales.

text.p: State-owned China National Petroleum Corp (Sinopec) has criticised oil enterprises for boosting diesel sales by forcing petrol buyers to purchase diesel oil, the Economic Information Daily said on Wednesday.
Some Chinese oil enterprises had been refusing buyers petrol unless they bought diesel in order to counteract falling sales caused by increased diesel smuggling, the newspaper said.

However, sluggish sales of diesel were caused by structural problems in the production process and could only be reversed through structural change and development of new products, it quoted Sinopec president Sheng Huaren as saying.
Sinopec had increased reserves and reorganised production structures to help boost sales, he said.
The state had cracked down on diesel smuggling in certain coastal areas that had been fuelled by a drop in international crude oil prices in April this year, he said.
The Economic Information Daily gave no further details of how many buyers had been forced to purchase diesel or how much was involved.
